blurb: With hundreds of access points and over 50 primitive campsites, the Connecticut River offers a unique paddling experience through the heart of New England. The Connecticut River Paddlers’ Trail connects primitive campsites and river access points from its headwaters in New Hampshire’s Great North Woods south to Long Island Sound, supported by a network of partner organizations.
